notes: Magento 2 storefront; robots.txt explicitly allows ClaudeBot. Direct fetch worked for all pages (no WAF/bot-block encountered). Qty verified via the site's own PLP toolbar text 'Showing N results from Total X for <Category>' (exact string, not a Shopify-style products_count -- this site runs Magento, not Shopify). One category (LED Designer Series) had zero products; verified via the embedded GraphQL productSearch JSON blob showing total_count:0, recorded as qty 0 (a real answer, not null). Despite the 'Teak' furniture-sounding name this is primarily a lighting specialist per the brief; Furniture (Sofas/Armchairs/Tables/Beds/Storage) and Ceiling Fans/Air-Circulator Fans nav branches exist on-site but were excluded per scope. Traversed the full mega-menu plus the Home Decor page's own on-page subcategory tiles (Vases>Table/Floor/Ceramic/Glass; Decor Accessories>Candle Holders/Trays&Baskets/Decorative Boxes/Planters/Wine&Magazine Holder; Wall Decor>Wall Art/Paintings), one level deeper than the header/footer nav. Rule 0 gains: kept all room-labelled lighting subcats (Living/Bedroom/Duplex/Dining Room Lights; Kid's Room Wall/Ceiling Lights) as legitimate cross-cuts of real lighting product types, matching the brief's own 'Lighting by Room' example; kept Mirrors, Vases, Wall Art/Paintings, Sculptures, Artifacts as decor is in scope even for a lighting-labelled company. EXCLUDED as scope violations: Ceiling Fans (all subcats incl. Wall/Pedestal Fans), all Furniture branches, 'Chandeliers Below 30000' (price filter), 'Sale'/'New Arrival'/'Best Sellers'/'Exclusive Collection' variants on every category (explicit NEVER-EXTRACT), the large long-tail of Magento layered-navigation SEO facet URLs found only via sitemap_category.xml (per-type cuts by room/size/color/material, e.g. 'bedroom-chandeliers', 'large-pendant-lights', 'metal-wall-lights' -- pure filter pages, not merchant-curated nav categories), and ~15 city-based local-SEO landing pages (e.g. /bangalore/chandeliers-in-bangalore/), which are duplicate-content location doorway pages. EXCLUDED as non-fixture components (bulb/wiring-adjacent, verified by inspecting product titles): 'LED Modules' (titles are bare 'Recessed LED Module' light engines, i.e. bulb-like replaceable elements), 'Architectural Light Components' (titles are LED drivers/rectifiers/track connectors -- wiring accessories), 'Ceiling Plates' (mounting canopy hardware), 'LED Track Lights' (the 2 listed SKUs are actually a track connector and a rectifier, not fixtures). EXCLUDED as mixed-type roll-ups after title inspection (site's own style/material cross-cut collections spanning multiple already-counted product types, not a distinct product line): 'Modern Home Decor' aka 'A Touch Of Marble' home-decor variant, the generic /home-decor/ hub itself (849, the umbrella mixed roll-up of Sculptures+Artifacts+Vases+Decor Accessories+Wall Decor+Mirrors), and 'Wooden/Ceramic/Metal/Luxury Home Decor' (titles mix decorative boxes, candle holders, marble/glass decor, and even kitchenware/drinkware across the tag). EXCLUDED as functional drinkware/bar tools: 'Flask and Carafe' (5 SKUs, titles are 'Leather Thermos Flask', 'Glass Carafe', 'Set of Glass Jars'). EXCLUDED as non-listing marketing/landing pages with no real product grid: Oina ('geometric-lighting-oina-spiral-collection') and Anisora designer-collection lookbook pages, and 'Stone Veneer' (a lighting-adjacent CMS page, not a catalogue listing). EXCLUDED as duplicates/redirects into already-counted pages: 'sculptures-and-artifacts' (301s to /home-decor/sculptures/), 'home-decor/candle-holders-and-lanterns' and 'tissue-and-decorative-boxes' and 'planters' and 'trays-serveware' (all redirect into the already-counted decor-accessories/ children), 'wall-art-clocks' (redirects to wall-decor/wall-art/), 'marble-home-decor' and 'resin-home-decor' (both redirect to the generic /home-decor/ hub, i.e. dead/removed categories). No duplicate-company match found in this project's roster; 'The White Teak Company' / whiteteak.com is a standalone Indian lighting-and-decor retailer with no other listing under this name.
